usedFor: Publora publishes social posts, and Google Sheets keeps a log through “Add Multiple Rows” when “New Post Published” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “New Post Published” in Publora, then “Add Multiple Rows” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Every published post becomes a row in a sheet, giving you a running log.

watchOut: A post fires “New Post Scheduled” and later “New Post Published”, so using both logs it twice.
